memory_candidates.content: When a plan or docstring specifies an invariant verified via `grep -F`/`grep` (e.g. a preserved clause or a cross-referenced heading phrase), the target string must sit on a single physical line in the file -- grep matches per-line by default, so a literal string split across a line-wrap point will never match, even in the pre-edit original. Verify this empirically (test the check against `git show HEAD:<file>` before assuming the wrap is fine) rather than trusting the plan's suggested word-wrap.
